title: Palermo vs Juventus friendly kicks off the season
seoTitle: Palermo vs Juventus friendly kicks off the season
subtitle: Juventus faces Palermo in Perth, decisive test before Serie A
excerpt: Juventus and Palermo meet in a friendly on Tuesday at 12 pm Italian time at HBF Park in Perth, a match that precedes Juventus' campaign in Serie A.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A friendly between Palermo and Juventus will be played today at 12 pm (Italian time) at HBF Park in Perth, marking the first official match of Juventus' preparation for the upcoming Serie A season.

Match details

The match is scheduled to start exactly at 12:00 Italian time, as announced by the Italian sports press. The fixture will take place at HBF Park stadium in Perth, Australia, and is part of Juventus' pre‑season friendly series.

Juventus' view of the competition

According to executive Filippo Inzaghi, Juventus will be one of the protagonists of the next Serie A, alongside teams such as Inter, Napoli and Como. Inzaghi highlighted the squad depth and the importance of the recent appointment of Carnevali to the board, indicating confidence in the team's performance throughout the season.

Comments from Juventus coach

Coach Massimiliano Spalletti explained that goalkeeper Perin will start in this match, a decision already planned before training began. Spalletti also noted that striker Gatti will not start due to mild fatigue, remaining available to come on if needed.

Possible line‑ups and substitutions

Spalletti indicated that the strategy for the friendly includes 20‑ to 30‑minute rotations, allowing the evaluation of different player combinations. He emphasized that the plan foresees two game periods, with possible changes during the second half as the team requires.

Impact on the Serie A landscape

Inzaghi reiterated that Juventus intends to compete for the title until the end, staying among the top teams in the competition. The performance against Palermo will be watched as an indicator of the squad's strength before the official start of Serie A, especially alongside rivals such as Inter, Napoli and Como.

With information from www.art-news.it.
